description: This file defines classes and fields related to Swiss bank information and partner bank details in an Odoo module, including inheritance and custom fields for bank identifiers, account details, and printing options.

classes.name: Bank
classes.description: Inherit res.bank class to add Swiss-specific fields like clearing number and city.

classes.name: ResPartnerBank
classes.description: Override of res.partner.bank with additional fields for account details, BVR/ESR printing options, and custom name display.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Override to customize display name of bank records to include partner link and bank type.
